batch: 6 (chs 40-48, Part II: comfort and the LORD vs the idols)

units.characteristics: comfort to the pardoned; the frailty of flesh vs the enduring word; the God who carries the flock
units.gist: GEM - 'COMFORT, comfort my people... speak tenderly to Jerusalem, her warfare is ended, her iniquity is pardoned'; 'ALL FLESH IS GRASS... but the word of our God will stand forever'; 'he will tend his flock like a shepherd; he will gather the lambs in his arms; he will CARRY THEM IN HIS BOSOM' - tender comfort; frail flesh vs enduring word; the God who carries

units.characteristics: the discouraged 'my way is hidden'; waiting on God renews strength
units.gist: THE GEM - the incomparable Creator (nations a drop from a bucket); 'why do you say, O Jacob, MY WAY IS HIDDEN FROM THE LORD, and my right is disregarded?'; 'he gives power to the FAINT... they who WAIT FOR THE LORD shall RENEW THEIR STRENGTH; they shall MOUNT UP WITH WINGS LIKE EAGLES; run and not be weary; walk and not faint' - the discouraged heart answered; waiting renews

units.characteristics: fear not, I am with you; the worm upheld; idols are empty wind
units.gist: THE GEM - 'FEAR NOT, for I am with you; be not dismayed, for I am your God; I will strengthen you, I will help you, I will UPHOLD YOU with my righteous right hand'; 'fear not, you WORM Jacob... your Redeemer is the Holy One'; the poor seeking water answered; the idols 'are a delusion... empty wind' - the fearful upheld; the contemptible cherished

units.characteristics: the gentle, un-showy, persevering servant; the bruised reed not broken
units.gist: SERVANT SONG 1 - 'behold my servant, whom I uphold, my chosen, in whom my soul DELIGHTS; I have put my Spirit upon him'; 'he will not cry aloud or lift up his voice in the street; a BRUISED REED he will not BREAK, and a faintly burning WICK he will not QUENCH'; 'he will not grow faint or be discouraged' - the tender, quiet strength that does not crush the weak

units.characteristics: seeing but not observing; the servant blind and deaf; not taking it to heart
units.gist: the new song of praise; then the paradox - 'who is BLIND but my servant, or DEAF as my messenger? He SEES many things but does not OBSERVE them; his ears are open but he does not HEAR'; the plundered people who 'did not take it to heart' - open eyes/ears that do not perceive; suffering not laid to heart

units.characteristics: you are mine, redeemed and precious; presence through the waters; the new thing; sins blotted
units.gist: THE GEM - 'FEAR NOT, for I have redeemed you; I have called you BY NAME, YOU ARE MINE. When you pass through the WATERS I WILL BE WITH YOU... when you walk through fire you shall not be burned'; 'you are PRECIOUS in my eyes, and honoured, and I LOVE you'; 'I am doing a NEW THING'; 'I, I am he who BLOTS OUT your transgressions for my own sake'

units.characteristics: fear not; the Spirit poured on the thirsty; belonging named
units.gist: 'FEAR NOT, O Jacob my servant... I will POUR WATER on the thirsty land, and my SPIRIT upon your offspring'; 'this one will say, I AM THE LORD'S... another will write on his hand, The LORD'S' - the Spirit poured on the parched; belonging freely claimed and confessed

units.characteristics: the self-deception of idolatry; the deluded heart feeding on ashes; blotted out, return
units.gist: GEM - the idol-satire: half the wood warms him and bakes bread, the other half he worships, 'Deliver me, for you are my god!'; 'he FEEDS ON ASHES; a DELUDED HEART has led him astray, and he cannot say, Is there not a LIE IN MY RIGHT HAND?'; then 'I have BLOTTED OUT your transgressions like a cloud... RETURN to me' - self-deceived worship; the deluded heart; the call to return

units.characteristics: the clay disputing its Maker; the God who hides himself; turn to me and be saved
units.gist: GEM - Cyrus named though 'you do not know me'; 'WOE to him who STRIVES with him who formed him, a pot among earthen pots! Does the CLAY say to him who forms it, What are you making?'; 'truly you are a GOD WHO HIDES HIMSELF'; 'TURN TO ME AND BE SAVED, all the ends of the earth, for I am God and there is no other' - the clay's presumption; the hidden God; the universal call to turn

units.characteristics: idols that must be carried vs the God who carries; his counsel that stands
units.gist: THE GEM - Bel and Nebo 'borne as BURDENS on weary beasts... they cannot save the burden'; against them 'you who have been BORNE BY ME from before your birth... even to your OLD AGE I am he, and to gray hairs I WILL CARRY YOU; I have made, and I will bear'; 'my counsel shall STAND, I will accomplish all my purpose' - the god you carry vs the God who carries you

units.characteristics: self-deifying complacency ('I am, and there is no one besides me'); secure in wickedness
units.gist: GEM - Babylon 'who sit securely, who say in your HEART, I AM, AND THERE IS NO ONE BESIDES ME; I shall not sit as a widow'; 'you FELT SECURE in your wickedness; you said, NO ONE SEES ME; your wisdom led you astray'; the sudden ruin her enchantments cannot charm away - the god-usurping self-security exposed

units.characteristics: the obstinate heart; refining in the furnace; the peace that could have been like a river
units.gist: GEM - 'I know you are OBSTINATE, your neck an IRON SINEW and your forehead brass'; 'I have REFINED you, but not as silver; I have TRIED YOU IN THE FURNACE OF AFFLICTION'; 'your Redeemer... teaches you to profit, leads you in the way you should go. Oh that you had paid attention to my commandments! Then your PEACE would have been like a RIVER'; 'no peace for the wicked'
